caveat_condition.penStipple_caveat_text: Pen Stipple moved from "Dots & stipple" to "Parallel hatching": it has never drawn dots — its highlight fade comes from shortening the fine nib's hatch marks, the same ruled-darks mechanism as the other Pen options. If you want an actual dot pattern, this option won't give you one.
